description: Post a text message into a Pondchat room. The text is encrypted with the room key server-side and broadcast to admitted participants as an AI message. Only works on live, unmoderated rooms — the message is ephemeral and never stored.

message.description: The plaintext message content (max 4000 chars / 4096 UTF-8 bytes). Encrypted with the room key before broadcast; never persisted.

roomId.description: The room ID to post into.

senderId.description: Optional stable identity for the agent (max 64 chars). Defaults to "mcp-agent".

senderName.description: Optional display name shown to participants (max 32 chars).

name: send_message
title: Send message
